sentences.en: Socially awkward children are more susceptible to bullying.
sentences.zh: 社交上不自在的孩子更容易受到欺凌。

sentences.en: Camgirls are especially susceptible to sexual harassment online.
sentences.zh: 网络主播特别容易遭受性骚扰。

sentences.en: The whales are susceptible to ship strikes and entanglements in fishing gear.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼容易遭到船只撞击和渔具缠绕事故。

senses.zh: 易受影响的；易感动的；容许…的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sus（下）+cept（拿）+ible（能…的）→能被拿下的→易受影响的
